topPRs.title: fix: apply Telegram setup token at runtime
topPRs.author: vyctorbrzezowski
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- apply validated Telegram setup tokens to runtime settings and process env
- restart the live Telegram service with the new token when available
- report connected only when the Telegram service is operational, and clear runtime token state on disconnect

Related to elizaOS/eliza#7240.

topPRs.title: fix: narrow telegram chat display names
topPRs.author: dutchiono
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- centralize Telegram chat display-name selection behind a narrowed helper
- avoid accessing chat fields that are not present on every Telegraf chat variant

## Why
Windows Milady installs were surfacing a TypeScript build failure in this plugin because `ctx.chat` is a union and the code accessed `title`, `first_name`, and `username` without narrowing.

## Validation
- bun run build
